type_name: A label that defines the generalised category of an asset area, based on shared characteristics or function.
last_modified_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the asset area was modified the last time in DKG.
created_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the asset area was created in DKG.
type_id: The globally unique id of the asset area type, generated by DKG using uuidv5.
name: A descriptive identifier for a group of assets, typically indicating what they are about or governing entity.
id: The globally unique id of the asset area generated by DKG using uuidv5.
last_modified_by: The identifier of the user in DKG who modified the asset area the last time.
display_name: The display name that will be used in UIs, e.g., marketplace, in title case.
created_by: The identifier of the user in DKG who created the asset area.
